description: The Stroop color challenge — a color word appears in a mismatched ink color. Tap the button matching the INK color, not the word, against the clock.

faqs.a: You must tap the button matching the color of the ink the word is written in — not what the word says. That conflict is the famous Stroop effect.
faqs.q: What am I supposed to match?

faqs.a: You get 45 seconds. +1 for each correct tap, −1 for each wrong one.
Your best score is saved in this browser.

howto: Press Start — a color word appears in a mismatched color.
Tap the button for the INK color (ignore the word).
+1 for correct, −1 for wrong. 45 seconds on the clock.
title: Color Match Game
